description: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer: a 3D game where kids complete missions inspired by real astronaut training: launch checklists, spacewalk repairs, station resource management and emergencies. Seymur (Unity, C#, Blender, Photoshop) builds the 3D world. Ali (Python, Java, security) handles backend and keeps it safe for kids. Huseyn (Python, art design) leads UI and visuals. We love space, games, AI and cybersecurity, and want to make STEM learning feel like a real mission.
summary: SolSurvivor is a 3D exploration game that lets children feel real space science instead of reading it. A junior astronaut and the robot Bip walk on the Moon, Mars, Europa and Titan under each world's real gravity and scan 24 discoveries. Each one opens a card with a short animation, one real number and its NASA or ESA source. Oxygen, power and radiation make the player plan every trip. On the Moon, children become space weather forecasters: they take a real coronal mass ejection from NASA's DONKI database, work out from its measured speed when it will arrive, and bet their walk on that forecast. After each mission, a report with quiz results can go to the teacher.
details: SolSurvivor is a 3D exploration game where kids feel real space science instead of reading about it. You play a junior astronaut who, with a robot friend called Bip, walks on the Moon, Mars, Europa and Titan, each with its real gravity. Across the four worlds there are 24 real discoveries to scan, and each one opens a card with a short animation, one real number and its NASA or ESA source. Oxygen, power and radiation run down as you explore, so you have to plan every trip and get back to base in time. On the Moon you become a space weather forecaster: Bip shows a real coronal mass ejection from NASA's DONKI database, and you work out from its measured speed when it will reach you. Your forecast becomes the countdown on screen, but the storm arrives at the real time, so a bad guess leaves you six seconds to find shelter. Every discovery is also a survival tool, so scanning a lunar pit pins it as a storm shelter and scanning MOXIE lets you turn power into oxygen.
